evidence.decision: Chooses short entry versus extended text/selection and resolves purpose, secure content, validation moment and locale semantics.
evidence.artifact: Requires input changes or a field contract naming label, type, validation, feedback, formatting and focus behavior.
evidence.transformation: Price example replaces disappearing placeholder purpose and per-keystroke decimal rejection with persistent labeling and locale-aware partial/committed validation.
evidence.verification: Checks empty/partial/invalid/valid input, locales, secrets, Tab order and long values; fails meaning-changing coercion or lost valid entry.
evidence.applicability: Preserves useful validation timing, iOS/iPad Clear, Mac suggestion/free-entry option and reduced TV/watch typing without claiming native execution.
evidence.handoffs: Loads entering-data for form strategy, virtual-keyboards for layout and text-views for extended content.
evidence.distinctiveness: Partial versus committed input and persistent purpose are consequential text-field choices tied to an actual entered-value failure.
